outline:
先修課程：負責教授同意。材料性質、製程與結構之關係、機械基礎-彈性行為、塑性基本理論。冶金基礎-單晶的塑性變形、差排理論、強化機構、材料的破壞。
Mechanical Fundamentals: Introduction, stress and strain relationships for Elastic Behavior, Elements of the theory of Plasticity, etc..
Metallurgical Fundamentals: Plastic Deformation of Single Crystal, Dislocation Theory, Strengthening Mechanism, Fracture, etc..
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction (1)
Week 2: Physics of Deformation (2)
Week 3: Mechanical Testing & Properties of Materials (3)
Week 4: Strengthening Mechanisms in Metals/Alloys (4)
Week 5: Materials in Engineering (5)
Week 6: Stress-Strain Relations & Deformation Models (6)
Week 7: Elasticity & Viscoelasticity (7)
Week 8: Complex/Principal Stresses & Strains (8)
Week 9:	Midterm Exam
Week 10: Plasticity & Superplasticity (9)
Week 11: Torsion in Shafts (10)
Week 12: Failures Theories & Design (11)
Week 13: Fracture Mechanics & Design (12)
Week 14: Fatigue Behavior of Materials (13)
Week 15: Creep Behavior of Materials (14)
Week 16: Mechanical Behavior of Composite Materials (15)
Week 17: Reviews
Week 18: Final Exam
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

Zainul Huda, "Mechanical Behavior of Materials," Springer, 2022.

5.	Keith Bowman, Mechanical Behavior of Materials, Wiley, 2003.
6.	Thomas H. Courtney, Mechanical Behavior of Materials, Waveland, 2005.
7.	William F. Hosford, Mechanical Behavior of Materials, Cambridge, 2010.
